summary: Frontend-only testing of Parchi Builder tab navigation and screen rendering. All 5 tabs (Home, Recent, Filter, Parchi, Settings) render correctly with proper content. Tab bar active state highlighting works correctly. Login screen verified. One route conflict bug found: app/filter.tsx redirect fails on direct page load to /filter URL.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct page load to /filter URL causes React error: 'Attempted to navigate before mounting the Root Layout component'. Root-level app/filter.tsx conflicts with app/(tabs)/filter.tsx - both map to /filter URL. The redirect calls router.replace() in useEffect before Root Layout is ready.

react_native_issues.component: All screens using shadow* style props
react_native_issues.issue: MINOR: Deprecated shadow* style props (shadowColor, shadowOffset, shadowOpacity, shadowRadius) warned to use boxShadow instead. Not functional but shows console warnings.

action_items: FIX: Remove or fix app/filter.tsx redirect. Either delete the file (no longer needed since tab navigation handles /filter routing) or replace router.replace() in useEffect with Expo Router's <Redirect> component to avoid the 'navigate before mounting' error.
OPTIONAL: Replace deprecated shadow* style props with boxShadow equivalent to remove console warnings
critical_code_review_comments: app/filter.tsx has router.replace('/(tabs)/filter') in useEffect - this causes 'Attempted to navigate before mounting the Root Layout component' error on direct URL navigation. Fix: use <Redirect href='/(tabs)/filter' /> from expo-router instead, or delete file.
Route conflict: Both app/filter.tsx and app/(tabs)/filter.tsx map to /filter URL. The root-level redirect is a leftover from pre-refactor and conflicts with the new tab routing.

app/store.ts exports dummy default export to satisfy Expo Router - there's a cleaner solution: move utils/store.ts outside of the app directory structure entirely, or just keep the utils/store.ts import. The warnings about missing default export are suppressed by the workaround.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (26/27 UI checks passed; 1 route bug found)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 tabs work when navigating from within the app. The only bug is direct page navigation to /filter URL shows an error. Filter form with size/rate inputs and Search/Clear buttons are in the code but cannot be tested visually without loading actual Google Drive data (requires OAuth). Tab active highlighting (blue color) works correctly for all tabs when navigating within app. Login screen looks correct with Connect Google Drive button and 3 feature rows.
rca_of_issue: Bug: Direct navigation to /filter (page.goto('/filter') or bookmarked URL) renders app/filter.tsx (FilterRedirect component) instead of app/(tabs)/filter.tsx. FilterRedirect calls router.replace('/(tabs)/filter') in useEffect which fires before Root Layout is mounted, causing crash. Fix: Replace the useEffect router.replace with <Redirect href='/(tabs)/filter' /> component from expo-router, which handles the redirect safely within the render lifecycle. Alternatively, delete app/filter.tsx entirely as the tab navigation already handles the /filter route correctly when used from within the running app.
